description: Defines classes and methods for establishing SSL connections, including SSL socket parameters and the SSL connection job, within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: SSLSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for SSL socket connections, including connection type and proxy details.

classes.name: SSLConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of establishing an SSL connection, including proxy handling and SSL handshake.

methods.name: GetConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the type of connection (DIRECT, SOCKS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY).

methods.name: GetDirectConnectionParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for direct connection; valid only if connection type is DIRECT.

methods.name: GetSocksProxyConnectionParams
methods.description: Returns SOCKS proxy parameters; valid only if connection type is SOCKS_PROXY.

methods.name: GetHttpProxyConnectionParams
methods.description: Returns HTTP proxy parameters; valid only if connection type is HTTP_PROXY.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the SSL connection job.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates if the connection has been successfully established.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Callback when a connect job completes.

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns the number of connection attempts made.

methods.name: IsSSLError
methods.description: Indicates if the error was SSL-related.

methods.name: HandshakeTimeoutForTesting
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for SSL handshake.

methods.name: ResetStateForRestart
methods.description: Resets internal state for a restart of the connection process.

methods.name: ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Changes the priority of the connection attempt.
